text: The fact-check verdict produced while writing is no longer rewritten into a pass. When TextOS raises a truth alert, a person can read and correct the article, but no WordPress draft can be prepared from it. A single rule decides whether a TextOS article may go to WordPress: the fact-check passes and the article conforms to the marketing review policy, and anything else stays closed. A label on the screen is therefore the end of a check, not just the end of a draft.
